links.note: The object is implicit in the participle.
More is supplied in the comparison.
My share renders the portion falling to the speaker.
All of this renders the neuter plural all.
When expresses the temporal force of the participle.
Here is absent from the English.
His renders the article with a body part.
Quickly and the second conjunction are unexpressed.
The dative marks the place approached.
Was going on renders these things might be.
Therefore renders a connective whose usual sense is but or and.
Disobeyed renders passed by in relation to a command.
Again repeats the preceding description; Greek here says lived.
